messages:
mira (PM): short thread: we need a customer-facing 'residency playbook' and crisp GA gates for routing + multi-region + tenant isolation. sales wants language they can cite in scoping calls. what are the non-negotiables?
devin (Eng-Arch): non-negotiables: 1) enforced residency (no silent cross-region failover for locked tenants), 2) audit trail for all routing decisions, 3) documented migration path (shadow -> mirror -> cutover). also propose 3 profiles: locked, resilient, pooled.
sam (Infra): locked = dedicated placement metadata + egress ACLs + reserved node pools. resilient = prefer-local with warm standby and automated failover after grace window. pooled = global scheduler with batching/quantization. infra work is very different per profile.
nana (Sales): customers keep asking for a "contract-ready" statement: "region-locked with audit logs and rollback SLA". they want a preview of cost vs latency in the quote. two anchors are ready to pilot if we can promise a migration runbook.
mira (PM): draft GA gates (short bullets): 1) residency enforcement tests green, 2) end-to-end SLO verification (p95 + availability) for each profile, 3) two pilot cutovers with 14d stable metrics, 4) billing reconciliation within 3-5%, 5) migration runbook + support SLA.
devin (Eng-Arch): suggested SLOs: locked p95 <= 220ms in-region, resilient p95 <= 180ms (post-failover p95 measured), pooled p95 <= 300ms but target 30-50% cost reduction. GA availability >= 99.95 for paid contracts. include fallback policy: explicit tenant knob: prefer-local | prefer-cost | force-lock.
sam (Infra): tests we'll need: multi-region traffic replay, tenant-evacuation simulation, noisy-neighbor fuzz, and billing-tag reconciliation. ETA: locked path ~4 sprints, resilient ~2 sprints, pooled cost tuning ~3 sprints. reserved SKU needed for locked pilots.
legal-bot: reminder: attach residency addendum draft (RES-202) to the pilot contract template repo and loop legal early.
nana (Sales): important: Console must show cost delta when selecting a profile in the quote flow. customers won't sign blind. also need a simple sales one-pager describing cutover steps and rollback SLA.
mira (PM): migration story: shadow traffic + metrics comparison for min 7 days, mirror with limited % traffic for 7 days, then DNS cutover with rollback window. gate GA on two pilots with stable metrics for 14 days post-cutover. record cutover metrics: latency delta, error-rate delta, and cost delta.
devin (Eng-Arch): implementation note: policy stored as tenant metadata with derived fields for hot-path routing decisions to avoid per-request JSON parse. policy sketch for Console/API (informal): tier=locked|resilient|pooled; region_pin=<region|null>; failover_grace_s=60.
sam (Infra): ops note: we need an audit sink for routing events and an override audit trail for emergency force-fallbacks. plan to expose a tenant-level override with 10m auto-expiry.
mira (PM): prioritization: A) residency enforcement + audit logs, B) Console preview + API policy editor, C) reserved SKU + pricing model, D) pooled profile cost optimizations. Action items: devin -> spec + acceptance tests (EOW). sam -> reserved SKU worksheet + infra ETA (Tue). ana -> pull 2 pilot commitments + legal contacts (Mon). I'll draft playbook and pilot pack.
nana (Sales): ack. pinging anchors now. :rocket:
devin (Eng-Arch): one more: include a soft-landing pattern for existing tenants: default to resilient unless customer opts into locked. that reduces risky cutovers.
mira (PM): good call. thanks everyone, scheduling follow-up mid-next-week.
